answer: A per-epoch bond drawn from spendable balance prices each identity out of the Sybil game: a fresh address must lock real value before it may attest, and that lock is slashed when its votes match a colluding cluster. An attacker spinning a thousand puppet keys must fund a thousand overlapping bonds, all frozen until the checkpoint clears, so every fake seat costs the same as an honest one. The lotus of bonus rewards no longer pays for volume, and identity becomes a velvet curtain of capital rather than a free alias, leaving the attack atlas flat.
